chapter: Later years and the New Orleans scene
title: Hearing New Orleans bands as a young man
summary: Labat recalls Imperial Band, Manuel Perez and Picou, and Joe Oliver at the Winter Garden.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Well, I used to listen to, I believe it was the Imperial man with Manuel Réa and Pico. And then... Was Pico playing with us? He was playing the clarinet with Manuel Réa. They used to play at the old fros and I remember most of the time.
Late old NSH Ristar playing. That's right. And you were young then? Yeah.
I used to go up on the Winter Garden. He was Joe Oliver. Joe Oliver played up there. Remember that was Winter Garden.
No, you don't remember. You can't tell that time you remember. And you was a little bit of boy. I was a young man. I was a young man. I wasn't a young man. I remember Shane. A young man.
